nodes.name: jest.config.ts
nodes.summary: Jest configuration for the eslint-rules project (eslint-rules) running in a Node environment with the standard SWC TypeScript transform from the shared jest-utils helpers.

nodes.name: jest-utils.ts
nodes.summary: Shared Jest configuration helpers for @swc/jest-based projects: converts tsconfig path aliases into a Jest moduleNameMapper and exports reusable SWC transform presets (standard, define-fields, decorators, NestJS, TSX) plus standard transformIgnorePatterns and module extensions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses 'as const' literal assertions so the SWC option objects keep narrow literal types expected by the transformer config.

nodes.name: pathsToModuleNameMapper
nodes.summary: Converts TypeScript compilerOptions.paths entries into Jest moduleNameMapper regex keys, replacing each wildcard with numbered capture groups and prefixing the target path.
